commands.name: recognize-enterprise
commands.description:
Recognize long audio or video
Recognizes music from long audio and video files using AudD's enterprise endpoint.

options.name: --url
options.description: URL of the file or page to scan.

options.name: --file
options.description: Audio or video file to scan.

options.name: --filename
options.description: Audio or video file to scan.

options.name: --accurate-offsets
options.description: Set to true to request accurate start and end offsets.

options.name: --skip
options.description: Number of 12-second chunks skipped after recognized chunks.

options.name: --every
options.description: Number of chunks to recognize in a row.

options.name: --limit
options.description: Upper bound for the number of chunks to recognize.

options.name: --skip-first-seconds
options.description: Seconds to skip before starting recognition.

options.name: --use-timecode
options.description: Set to true to use time information from the submitted URL as skip_first_seconds.

options.name: --input
options.description: Load request JSON from a file path, '-' for stdin, or an inline JSON object/array string.

options.name: --request-json
options.description: Request body as JSON.

options.name: --request-file
options.description: Path to a JSON request file, or '-' for stdin.

Reads stream recognition callbacks via long polling. This endpoint uses a longpoll category, not the API token.

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Long poll timeout in seconds.

options.name: --since-time
options.description: Timestamp from the previous longpoll response.
